rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for money returned by a shop or service provider.

example.english: The shop said they can refund me tomorrow.
example.traditional: 間舖頭話聽日可以回水畀我。
example.jyutping: gaan1 pou3 tau4 waa6 ting1 jat6 ho2 ji5 wui4 seoi2 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this formal or administrative term when referring to a refund in official or written contexts.

example.english: If the service cannot be provided, you may apply for a refund according to the procedure.
example.traditional: 如未能提供服務，可按程序申請退款。
example.jyutping: jyu4 mei6 nang4 tai4 gung1 fuk6 mou6 ho2 on3 cing4 zeoi6 san1 cing2 teoi3 fun2
